copy.heroHeading: Designed and built by the same hands
copy.storyHeading: A studio that refused to stop building
story: Kayu & Kapur began in 2017 as a two-person design practice. We kept watching good drawings get built badly by contractors who had never been in the room when the decisions were made.

So we opened our own carpentry workshop and started building what we drew. Nine years on we are still deliberately small — nine people — because the moment we grow past that, someone else starts answering for the detail.

process.title: Discovery
process.text: A long first conversation about how you use your home — where you eat, where things pile up, what annoys you about the current layout. Design that skips this step produces spaces that photograph well and live badly.

process.title: Design
process.text: Layout studies first, then 3D visualisation and a physical material board you can hold. Two rounds of revision are included, and we would rather you change your mind here than on site.

process.title: Build
process.text: The same studio that designed it builds it, with joinery made in our own workshop. Nothing gets value-engineered behind your back to protect a margin.
